name: review-coordinator-stale-check
title: PARKED: Review coordinator replays a stale sd-check failure remediated outside the content digest
description: sd-review caches the typed sd-check result in coordinator state keyed on an identity that excludes --attempt, so a check failure remediated outside tracked content — the Obsidian KB refresh — replays forever and no documented argument reaches a live re-run. Third recurrence; previously misdiagnosed as an environment isolation artifact.
